Muted Color Watch.name: Muted Color Watch
Muted Color Watch.description: The user changes their skin color to blend into a wall, foliage or rubble within arm's reach for the rest of the scene while holding mostly still. Ordinary visual searches can overlook them, allowing observation of a nearby room or street. Rapid movement, uncovered equipment, sound or touch reveals the user, and maintaining the color match tires their muscles. Strain: heavy.
